Franco clashes with Sonny and he warns him to stay away from Carly as he knows his secret. Carly tells Sonny that she is sure Franco won’t tell anyone who shot AJ. Michael shows Morgan one of the brownstones on the riverfront, and it’s in a right mess. Morgan is given the chance to renovate the place. Kiki offers to help Morgan renovate the place. Levi shows up with Maxie and announces that he is going to put a stop to the renovations. Tracy manages to sneak into Michael’s office and calls Luke and tells him she’s in and ready to take Michael down. Tracy sees a file about the riverfront revitalization project and is intrigued. Michael wonders what she is doing in his office after he shows up. Franco shows up to see Michael. Rafe says sorry to Molly for the way he treated her and leaves after deciding to talk to Sam later. Sam scrapes some of the paint and decides to try and find out where the car was repaired. Rafe takes some flowers to the grave. Sam is shocked by what she finds out after she learns where the car was taken to.

Ava answers the door to her mother and introduces Delia to Sonny. Delia announces that she's moving in to look after her daughter. Michael doesn't want to talk to Franco and Carly shows up stopping him from telling Michael the truth. Michael receives a call and leaves. Franco tells Carly that he just wants to free both her and Michael from Sonny and they end up arguing. Carly makes him promise to keep her secrets and they end up hugging. Kiki and Morgan begin work on the brownstone. Levi remains determined to stop the project and he and Maxie stage a sit in. After Michael shows up, Levi informs him that he's to blame. Michael threatens to have them arrested as Maxie insists on supporting Levi. Michael decides to call the police. Sam informs Patrick that the car belongs to Silas. Nina pays the therapist at the hospital to help her deceive Silas. Rafe asks Silas to lend him some money. Patrick and Sam show up and inform Silas that the evidence they've found leads straight to him.

Tracy talks to Luke on the phone about what a mistake she thinks Michael is making. Alice hears them talking on the phone. Levi and Maxie continue with their protest as Nathan and the police show up. Nathan has Levi arrested and has him dragged out. Maxie ends up being arrested as well. Dante and Olivia wait on the results from Lulu's procedure and they talk about Sonny. They learn from the doctor  that they've managed to repair Lulu's uterus. Shawn returns to town and Sonny inform him about the Ava situation and gives him the phone recording. Ava tells her mother that Sonny is planning to kill her. Ava thinks that if she can get the recording, she can go to the police and Sonny won't have any leverage. Ava wants Delia to get the recording for her. Patrick explains to Silas that his car ran him off the road as Rafe listens in. Kiki shows up admits she was supposed to drive the car that night but left it at the apartment. Sam realizes that Rafe could have taken it.

Rafe listens in as Sam, Patrick, Silas and Kiki realize he must have been the person driving the car. Silas wants to talk to him first before anyone confronts him. Patrick wants to be there though. When Nina and Rosalie show up Kiki tells them there is a crisis involving Rafe. Rafe runs off. Dante and Olivia learn from Patrick that they found the other driver in the accident and it was Rafe. Dante calls in an APB. Molly and TJ are in the park to watch the fireworks where she admits that she isn’t ready to go back to her mom’s house yet. Molly also tells him about Rafe’s visit, and that he apologized for they way he behaved. After TJ tells her that he saw Rafe taking coke she leaves to go talk to Silas. Ned meets with Alexis and tells her he’s sorry to hear about what happened to Ric. Ned gives her Tracy and Luke’s annulment papers. Tracy threatens Alice while she is on the phone with Michael and Alice ends up collapsing. Michael and Morgan leave the Brownstone after hearing about what has happened to Alice. Nathan ends up being cuffed to Maxie and the key goes missing. Tracy tells Morgan and Michael that she just found Alice on the floor and Morgan performs CPR on her. Alice is rushed to the hospital. Nina is furious about Silas’ situation. Rafe shows up and listens in and can see Nina is up and about. Nina thinks that they need to help each other after he confronts her and she offers him $500 to leave and keep her secret. Dante and the police show up at the apartment.

Nikolas and Spencer show up to pick up Elizabeth from the hospital to go watch the fireworks whilst Britt calls her mother for help. Spencer receives a text message from Britt to meet him. Elizabeth finds out that she is needed as the hospital as Britt and Spencer work on a plan for him to see Emma and her to see Nikolas. Britt and Spencer are pleased after their plan works. Nathan and Maxie are still cuffed together and take a rest in the park. Nathan blames Levi for what has happened and Maxie accuses him of not taking responsibility for his own problems. Alexis finds TJ waiting for Molly and he informs her that she went to talk to Silas. Britt and Nikolas talk about the past that they shared. Spencer takes Emma to watch the fireworks after she and her father have a heart to heart. Dante sees Nina on the floor and she says Rafe did this to her. Rosalie attempts to convince Rafe to forget what happened upstairs. Molly shows up after Rosalie leaves and tells Rafe that she knows about the drugs. After Rafe attempts to leave, Molly gets into the car with him. Rosalie returns to the apartment and tells everyone that Rafe has got away. Rosalie leaves and Silas apologizes to Nina. Sam and Dante go the garage and see Rafe and Molly in the car. Dante pulls Sam out of the way as Rafe races off. Dante and Sam follow them in a police car. Sam calls Patrick and informs him what is happening. Rafe tells Molly that he caused the accident that killed the baby and that he did it on purpose. Molly demands to know why and he tells her that somebody made him do it. The car ends up hitting a roadblock.

Sonny looks at a photograph of him and Olivia as she shows up. She tells him that she can't stop thinking about how and continues that she misses him. Delia than shows up and it is revealed that Sonny was daydreaming. After Ava shows up Sonny leaves and she and her mother conspire to steal the evidence. Delia later sneaks into Sonny's office. Molly's unconscious following the crash but Rafe climbs out of the car and falls to the ground. Dante and Sam show up and attempt to help them. Silas and Nina watch the fireworks from his window as Kiki shows up concerned about Rafe. Silas calls Sam who tells him about the accident. Silas leaves and Nina thinks that Kiki should leave as well. Alexis and TJ run into Patrick and discuss Rafe's drug issues. Patrick tells them that Rafe is responsible for running him off the road and after Alexis calls Silas she learns about the latest accident. Tracy tells Monica at the hospital about Alice having a heart attack. Michael wants to know what Alice wanted to warn him about. Patrick confronts Rafe after he is brought into the hospital. Dante shows up and attempts to pull him away.

Ava calls her mother to remind her that unless she finds the flash drive she’s as good as dead. Ava works out that the drive is probably in the safe and tells her mother how to find it. Ava pretends that she’s talking to her daughter after Sonny enters the room. Jordan and Shawn run into each other whilst jogging in the park and they end up arguing. Delia opens the safe and gets her hands on the drive and then runs into Olivia as she is leaving. She pretends that she’s Sonny’s new assistant but Olivia refuses to leave and calls Sonny to come over. After he shows up, he takes Delia’s phone as it rings. Ava manages to inadvertently ask Sonny instead of of her mother if she has managed to open the safe and got the flash drive. Ava is upset after she finds out that he plan has been ruined. Sonny takes back the drive and tells Delia that she’s returning to New York. Sonny takes away Ava’s phone privileges after returning home. Monica informs Morgan, Tracy and Michael that Alice had a heart attack and she is not strong enough for bypass surgery and continues that she will need a transplant. Sam, Alexis and TJ keep vigil over Molly. When she finally wakes up she is confused but asks about Rafe. Dante wants to get a statement from Molly and she remembers they were driving fast and that Rafe told her he caused Patrick’s accident. Molly is not able to remember what else he told her though. Rafe finds it hard to tell Silas and Patrick something about the crash and has a seizure before he can say anything. Patrick later informs Sam that Rafe was trying to tell him something important. Silas informs them that the seizure was caused by fluid on the brain and he requires surgery to relieve the pressure. Lisel wants Patrick to the performs the surgery but both he and Silas believe it’s a bad idea. Liesl informs them there’s no one else who can do it. Franco informs Carly that Liesl has hired him at the hospital to help patients with art therapy.

Maxie and Nathan wake up on the couch together, still handcuffed. When Levi shows up he accuses them of playing sex games. Maxie tells him about her arrest and the lost key. Nathan agrees not to say anything after Levi informs Maxie that his visa has expired and Diane is trying to get him a new one sorted out. Anna and Jordan meet in the park where Jordan tell her about Mickey stopping Julian from telling her who his boss was. Anna decides to try and find out more about Mickey. After Anna leaves, Mickey shows up and wants Jordan to explain to him why she was talking with the police commissioner. Jordan manages to cover and Mickey wants her to join him for dinner. Nina talks to Silas on the phone and he informs her that Rafe is still in surgery. After Nina finishes the call, she is in a bad mood because she had to stay in her chair all night with Kiki while Silas was was with Sam. Nina hopes that Rafe doesn't recover, Julian finds Alexis upset at the hospital. Julian attempts to offer her some comfort as she tells him Rafe was on drugs. Sam brings Silas some coffee and he is concerned about Patrick operating on Rafe. Silas isn't happy that when he finds out that Sam knew Rafe was taking drugs and didn't tell him. Nina shows up as they are arguing. Rafe starts to bleed during the operation as Patrick fights with his conscious. Silas asks Patrick about Rafe after he comes out of surgery.

Nathan argues with Maxie about Levi. Lulu shows up after Nathan leaves and tells her the news about her procedure. They talk about the protest and the handcuff incident. After Lulu leaves an immigration agent shows up at the door. Lucas and Felix hang out together and Lucas hopes they can spend more toe together in the future. Brad shows up and after Felix leaves he wants to talk about what they had together. Lucas admits that he has developed feelings for Felix. Nathan talks to Dante about Maxie and Levi's antics and Dante fills him in about Rafe's accident.  Alice wakes up at the hospital and Monica tells her that she had a heart attack. Tracy stops Alice from saying anything. Alice tells Michael that they need to talk after everyone leaves the room. Kiki and Morgan share an awkward moment and she leaves. Nina listens in as Patrick tells Silas and Sam that Rafe is brain dead. Silas accuses Patrick of causing it to happen on purpose. Sam comes between them and takes Silas away to see Rafe. Nina shows up and puts her arm on Silas's shoulder after Sam leaves. Kiki cries on Morgan's shoulder after hearing the news about Rafe. Patrick tells Felix what's happened after he shows up. Brad interrupts Felix as he is taking a shower and tells him he has a bone to pick with him. Sam asks Patrick if he deliberately botched Rafe's operation.

The Immigration agent wants to talk to Levi and Maxie plays dumb. She is warned that she will be in trouble if she's harboring an alien. Maxie thinks that Nathan is the reason the agent showed up. Lulu goes to see Lucas at Carly's. Lulu thinks that he should go and talk to the man he really wants to be with. Brad startles Felix while he is having a shower in the locker room. Brad attempts to kiss Felix as Lucas shows up and he storms out. Brad goes after him and claims he just got carried away. Kiki informs Morgan and Tracy that Rafe is brain dead. Alice continues to try and tell Michael the truth but Tracy shows up and announces that there is now a donor. Tracy tells Alice that she owes her for this. Silas sits at Rafe's bedside vowing revenge if this is Patrick's fault. Sam wants Patrick to tell her whether he took revenge on Rafe. Sam believes him but doubts convincing Silas will be so easy.

Franco lets Carly know how his new job is going at the hospital and he apologizes for being stupid about Sonny. Sonny shows up to see Carly and tells her about Ava moving her mother and attempting to get her hands on the recording. Sonny thinks that Franco will always be a danger whilst he is still alive. Maxie and Levi wonder if Nathan called immigration on him as he shows up.They confront him and he denies it. Nathan ends up admitting to Maxie that he said something to Dante. Olivia and Lulu are with Dante and the baby at the Floating Rib where they discuss the possibility of having a new baby. Maxie shows up and asks Dante and Mac which one of them called immigration. Tracy is anxious for news about Rafe's heart and tells Monica about it. Kiki and Silas talk about the transplant. Liesl tells everyone that there is a problem because Rafe tested positive to heroin and the hospital can't allow a transplant now. Nina thanks Rafe for helping her drive a wedge between Sam and Silas as his hand moves and he stares at her. Nina attempts to keep herself calm, but Rafe yanks the oxygen tube out of his mouth. He taunts her and threatens to expose her secrets. When Franco shows up, Nina snaps out of it and Rafe is still comatose.

Felix talks to Sabrina on the phone as he does his rounds at the hospital. Brad interrupts him and is upset that he ruined things with Lucas for him. Felix doubts that Brad could actually sustain a relationship. After they both decide that Lucas is a lost cause they decide to go out for a drink. Both Dante and Mac deny calling immigration on Levi. Lucas talks to his father about the state of his love life. Sonny is furious after Carly admits that Franco nearly told Michael the truth. Sonny warns Franco when he shows up that his days will be numbered if Michael ever finds out the truth. Franco is upset with Carly. Jordan makes her way to the Metro Court for dinner with Mickey. After she runs in Shawn, they reminisce about the night they spent together. Shawn isn't happy when Mickey flirts with Jordan and warns him to back off. Mickey wants to take things further with Jordan.

Tracy and Michael are concerned about how to break it to Alice that she won’t get Rafe’s heart after all. Tracy promises to find Alice a better heart but wants her to keep quiet about about what she heard. Silas tells Nina that he heard her waking up during the night shouting out Rafe’s name. Silas enters Rafe’s room and Sam tells him his heart can’t be used for the transplant because of his drug use. Nikolas promises to take Spencer to see Alice if he behaves himself with the new counselor. Britt and Spencer continue to conspire after she shows up. Joss hears them talking and demands to know what they are talking about. Elizabeth sees Britt and Nikolas talking in the park. Kiki and Morgan support each other about Alice and Rafe. Molly remembers somebody put Rafe up to driving the car off the road but forgets again after she wakes up. She then learns that Rafe is brain dead. Michael returns to Alice’s room and hears Tracy asking Alice if they have a deal. Alice tells him that they just agreed to both do whatever it takes to find a new heart. Rafe's family and friends gather as his life support system is turned off. Nina sees Rafe comforting Sam.

Nathan returns home to find his clothes dumped outside the apartment and the locks changed. Nathan thinks that maybe Levis made the call to immigration himself which Maxie thinks is crazy. After Maxie tells Levi, there is a flashback to him making the call with Nathan’s phone. Nathan becomes determined to prove to Maxie that Levi is up to no good. Maxie tells Levi that she will go to Australia with him if he ends up being deported. Felix urges Elizabeth to fight for Nikolas. Spencer informs Cameron and Emma that he’s moving on with Joss but they didn't believe him even after he kisses her. Spencer tells Britt that he has a plan to break up his father and Elizabeth. Spencer reassures her that his plan will work. As Silas and Sam hug, Nina watches through the window. Nina then tells them that she has a confession to make but Sam and Silas ask her to tell them later. Silas is furious with Liesl for allowing Patrick to operate on Rafe. Sam and Silas argue again and she thinks he should take some time off work to grieve. Nina gets out of her chair to follow Sam and Silas to the roof where Sam urges Silas to think again about his decision. Nina listens as Sam tells Silas that Patrick admitted he thought about hurting Rafe, but couldn't go through through with it. Anna says sorry to Patrick for not identifying the driver of the car who caused the crash and wants to know why Rafe would want to have caused it. Anna asks him about Robin and asks if they’re getting a divorce. Liesl interrupts them and tells Patrick that Silas is thinking about going public with his accusations of malpractice. Sam urges Silas not to pursue a case against Patrick as Nina comes up with a plan.

Patrick gets ready for the press conference. Sam believes that she has convinced Silas that Patrick did everything he could to save Rafe. Anna confronts Liesl and accuses her of setting Patrick up to take a fall. Nina informs Rosalie that she heard Sam tell Silas in confidence that Patrick thought about killing Rafe and tells her about her plan to let it slip out at the press conference. Silas isn't happy when he sees Sam and Patrick talking. Nina puts her plan into action as the reporters start to show up. The press conference gets underway and Liesl goes over the details of Rafe’s car accident. A reporter asks if there could be a possibility that Patrick killed Rafe as he had a conflict of interests. Patrick assures him he did everything he could to try and save Rafe’s life. The reporter then wants to know he admitted he wanted Rafe dead and everyone gasps. Spencer checks into the Metro Court under the name Ron Moss. He then gets a text from Britt who tells him that she needs some more time. Nikolas is unable to find Spencer at the park and turns to Elizabeth and Britt for help. After Nikolas tracks Spencer on his phone, Britt calls him to warn him that he is one his way to the hotel. Nathan shows up at the police station and tells Dante about the latest development with Maxie. Levi shares his concerns with Maxie that Nathan is trying to tear them apart. Felicia and Mac talk about Levi’s situation at The Floating Rib. An upset Lucy shows up who is grieving Rafe’s death. Lucy admits to Felicia that she misses Scott and wishes she hadn’t pushed him away. Maxie and Levi show up and announce they are getting married. Lucy shows up to see Scott and a disheveled Bobbie opens the door.

Scott goes to the police station where he asks Anna to tell him why there were drugs in Rafe’s system and she suggests that he asks his friend Julian. Bobbie encourages Lucy to believe the worst and she is out of her mind with jealousy. Lucy knows she has to work through things with Scott and believes that Bobbie should not be involved with him. Bobbie says that Scott is dating her and she intends to use all the tricks she learned in the past to make sure it stays that way. Scott shows up and finds them rolling on the floor and wants to know why Lucy came to see him. An upset Lucy just leaves. Olivia gets everybody looking for Spencer while Nikolas realizes that his son's phone tracker isn’t working anymore. Nikolas is concerned that he might have been kidnapped and Olivia leaves to check the security video footage. Spencer texts Britt to look under the chair. Nikolas then finds a note from Spencer that mentions breakup with Britt. Anna shows up after Nikolas calls her and takes a look at the note. Olivia returns with news that Spencer got into a taxi. Britt receives another text message from Spencer that he will send his location later. Nathan accuses Maxie of marrying to Levi to stop his deportation. Mac warns her immigration will investigate the marriage. Levi asks Mac and Felicia for their blessing but Mac refuses to give it as Nathan talks to Maxie. The press conference continues at the hospital where the reporters hound Patrick with questions about his statements intending to harm Rafe. Nina is pleased with the chaos she has caused. Patrick takes Sam to one side and she promises she didn’t say anything. Silas accuses Sam of believing Patrick over him after she confronts him. Sam believes what Silas did is unforgivable and he swears on his life he didn’t tell a reporter anything. He then leaves to  take Nina home. Liesl tells Patrick that she has no choice left but to fire him. Julian confronts Jordan in the park and wants to know if she and Mickey are selling heroin.

Lucy fills Felicia in about Bobbie and Scott. Felicia is unable to take sides because she’s friends with both Bobbie and Lucy. She does offer Lucy some advise though. Scott thinks about Lucy whilst he is in bed with Bobbie. Lucy shows up to talk to Scott and Bobbie lets her in and she tells Scott that she wants him in her life. Bobbie wants him to make a choice about who he wants to be with. Jordan tells Anna that Julian was surprised to find out about the heroin, so his boss must have gone over his head. Jordan tells Anna about her plan to find out who he is. Ava goes to the hospital with Sonny and sees Morgan and tells him that she’s there for a baby checkup. Morgan doesn’t want to talk her and Sonny and attempts to walk away but Sonny follows him. Mickey introduces himself as Bob to TJ and quizzes him about Jordan. Julian tells Alexis in bed that was their last night together because he knows Molly will never come back in as long as he’s in her life and he suggests they see each other in secret for now. Alexis agrees to his plan. Ava calls Julian for help after bribing a nurse to let her use a phone. Ava wants Julian to help her in exchange for information that will take Sonny down for good. TJ answers Mickey’s questions about Jordan’s time in jail. The nurse that helped Ava agrees to distract Sonny while Julian enters Ava’s room. Rosalie is stood up and after she throws her phone it hits Morgan. They end up getting some ice together and flirt with one another.

Silas pushes Nina around the halls, as she promises him that she will take care of Rafe's funeral arrangements. Sam interrupts them and Nina leaves. Sam then informs Silas that Patrick was fired because of him. Sam thinks that things between them are not the same anymore. Sam is certain that Nina is out to get him back. Sam doesn't think he's ready to move on and ends things between them. Carly walks in on Franco doing art therapy and she is impressed by how much he's enjoying his new job. After Carly leaves, Nina shows up and she and Franco talk about her coma. Nina's enemies list falls out of her purse and Franco recognizes the names and she pretends she's just keeping track. Mickey runs into Alexis and recognizes her as a friend of Julian's. Molly agrees to go home with her mother. When Patrick returns home he catches Emma dumping her breakfast in anger. She refuses go to school and misses Robin. Elizabeth and Cameron show up after he convinces her to get ready for school. Kiki ends up telling him about Cary and Sonny sleeping together. Nina tells Rosalie about her revenge plans for Kiki. Nina wants Rosalie to try and seduce Michael but she refuses. Spencer attempts to backpedal with Emma but she demands some answers. Sam wants to know why Patrick did not tell her about the Crichton Clark card. Alexis plays with Danny as Julian shows up to see his grandson. Alexis allows him to come in just as along as he leaves before Molly returns home. Nathan and Maxie leave with the Aztec knife. Stavros holds a scalpel to Lulu’s neck and threatens to slit her throat after Dante shows up. Things heat up between Sam and Patrick but she stops things from going too far.

Nikolas tells Britt about the trouble at Crichton Clark. They talk about Victor and his role as the head of the WSB. Spencer walks in and wonders if Victor is coming to see them. Elizabeth fusses over the John Doe as Monica shows up and takes a look at him. John Doe opens his eyes as Elizabeth is about to leave. Nina finds Franco spying on Carly and Sonny with his phone. Sonny hopes that Carly will dump Franco to be with him. Carly refuses. Nina takes Franco's phone away and attempts to convince him to stop spying on Carly. Carly blames Sonny for Michael nearly being killed.Things end up heating up between them again. Franco gets his phone back from Nina and tells her she was right and offers to delete the camera app. As he turns it on, they see Sonny and Carly half-naked talking about what happened.

Nathan and Maxie find out more about each other over dinner. Nina suggests that Franco deletes the app as he smashes things. Monica talks to Silas about Sam, Danny and Jason. Silas tells her that he and Sam are no longer together. Elizabeth offers Jason some water and explains he was in an accident. He remembers it and Elizabeth asks him his name. Sam and Patrick knock on a hotel door and Tracy opens it. Tracy isn't pleased to see them and insists that she could of handled things. Patrick wonders if Tracy would cover for Luke. Tracy insists that if he is guilty then she will tell them because it would affect her too. Sam and Patrick find out that they’re booked into the same room and no others are available. Carly tells Sonny how guilty she feels. Sonny talks about Ava and his guilt about killing A.J. Nina is shocked as she and Franco hear Sonny's admission. Things heat up between Sonny and Carly again. Elizabeth gets a doctor to look at Jason. Jason says he remembers something and calls Elizabeth by name. Jason has a flashback and mentions Jake's name. Silas is shocked to see Nina standing in the corridor. Sonny wants Carly to tell everyone that they are seeing each other. Franco shows up as they are talking. Monica goes out on a date with Judge David Walters. David look at Nathan and Maxie in the restaurant.

Julian attempts to stop Alexis from leaving when she tells him she has a date with Ned. Alexis receives a call from her daughter. Julian continues to insist that Luke isn’t his boss but Alexis refuses to believe him. Alexis tells him they are through and leaves. Sam suggests to Patrick they just share the hotel room. They end up sharing a bed after Patrick finds it impossible to sleep on the floor, 

Judge Walters stops by Maxie and Nathan’s table and they end up arguing. Ned joins Monica at her table and she tells him about her internet date. Olivia shows up and thinks they are on a date together. Monica arranges a second date with Judge Waters. Nina tells Silas that  she was scared he would leave her and go back to Sam if he knew she could walk again. Elizabeth tells Jason that she had a son named Jake who died when he was just four years old. Carly opens the door and finds Franco is standing there. He wants to talk alone with Sonny about what’s going on with him and Carly. Carly insists that she is in love with him.

Spencer and Nikolas have breakfast at the Metro Court and Spencer says that he's nervous about what's going to happen today. Shawn sees Jordan at the hotel and they talk about somebody trying to kill Michael. Britt joins Nikolas and Spencer. Britt is invited to move back in. Britt is worried about Elizabeth and Nikolas insists that they are over. Sabrina goes to see Carlos to find out if he's certain Ava caused that accident. Carlos offers Sabrina some advise after he learns she gave Ava some pills that could harm her baby. Ava receives a text message from Jordan about her pills. Morgan tells Ava that Michael and Kiki have gone away because someone was after him. Ava doubles up in pain and Morgan leaves to get her pills. Silas tells Rosalie that she's fired as Nina shows up. Silas gives them a moment alone. Nina explains Silas caught her standing up and tells her she still has a job destroying Kiki by sleeping with Michael. Rosalie tells her about the hit on Michael's life. Rosalie says he wants to be with Kiki and she likes Morgan. Sam wakes up next to Patrick in the hotel room having dreamed of them making love. Patrick asks if Tracy has heard from Luke yet after she shows up. Tracy says she's meeting him today. Sam receives a call from Silas. Morgan sees Shawn and Jordan at Metro Court and Jordan gives him Ava's pills. Jordan receives a call from Sabrina and tells her she gave Ava the medication. Rosalie runs into Morgan outside his place and he attempts to get rid of her. Ava calls out for Morgan.

Sonny daydreams about pounding Franco’s face as he hits a punch bag at the gym. Shawn shows up and tells him Jordan has been stonewalling. Sonny tells him about Sam’s thoughts that Luke is working with the Jeromes. Sonny thinks that Franco needs to be eliminated so the truth about him killing AJ wont come out. Franco watches Bobbie and Carly through the evil eye. Scott shows up and asks Franco to join him and Bobbie for lunch. Franco thinks that Scott has chosen the wrong women to be with. Alexis tells Julian that Ned is her man now and not him. Nina leaves messages for Rosalie. Nina finds Franco and tells him that Silas knows about her walking. Silas hears Patrick in the background as he talks to Sam on the phone. Patrick thinks Silas wants to know if there’s still a chance for him and Sam. Bobbie thinks her daughter needs to face reality. Carly tells her that she has to stay with Franco and Sonny knows they can’t be together again. Duke and Anna arrive for a private lunch date but are interrupted by Lucy. Duke admits he invited her, and Lucy’s mood takes a turn for the worse as soon as she sees Bobbie. Scott and Carly clash about Sonny and Franco and Bobbie stops them before it gets out of hand. Duke drags Luke away after she argues with Bobbie. Jordan ignores Sabrina’s calls. Anna joins her and finds out that Morgan knows where Ava is. Lucy tells Anna and Duke that she has decided to leave town. Duke decides to drive Lucy home and leaves a frustrated Anna behind. Morgan hears Ava scream and rushes past Rosalie to get inside. Ava refuses to go to the hospital and just wants her pills.

Patrick and Sam go into a café in Amsterdam and sit in a corner and Patrick wonders if she is still thinking about Silas. Patrick wonders what Sam would do if Silas got divorced from Nina. Luke sends Tracy a message after she shows up and informs her that he is five minutes away. Liesl sees Nathan at the police station and he wonders what she did to have Anna bring her in. After Dante shows up, Nathan tells him about what happened with Maxie and the judge. Dante thinks that he see Maxie in secret. Liesl is released and she explains to Nathan that she killed his father for his sake. Epiphany checks in on Elizabeth and her John Doe at the hospital and asks her about Nikolas. Milo shows up to pick up Epiphany. After Jason wakes up he and Elizabeth wonder what his surname is. Elizabeth wants to send his prints to the police but Jason doesn't like that idea since he could be a criminal. Silas is surprised to walk into his office and find Nina there. After she leaves, Silas asks a nurse to call Nina's therapist. Maxie tells Lulu about her date with Nathan. Liesl receives a surprise when she goes to Nathan's apartment.

Jason worries about the police having his fingerprints and Elizabeth then mentions Lucky and then Jason. Elizabeth explains to him that Jason is dead. The plastic surgeon comes in wanting to unveil his patient's face. Silas calls Travis over to meet him at the nurse's station. Travis tells him that he can't say anything about Nina's case as she watches them talking. Silas then takes Travis into an exam room to question him further. Nina sends Travis a text message and Silas grabs his phone and after reading the message demands to be told the truth. Nina sends more incriminating texts. Silas warns Travis that he has committed a crime, but offers to keep it a secret if he tells him everything. Nathan runs into Maxie at the gym. A furious Anna asks Dante if Liesl has really been released and she tells him that she killed Victor. Liesl sees Madeline at Nathan's apartment and they end up arguing. Madeline tells her that the charges against her have been dropped. Jerry Jacks shows up at Tracy's table and she is shocked to see he is still alive. He explains to her that Luke saved him. Sam attempts to leave to get reinforcements but two thugs stop her. Jerry invites her and Patrick to join him and Tracy. Patrick believes that Luke is working with him. Luke sends Tracy a text message. Jerry reveals that he has Luke's phone and mocks Jason to upset Sam. He then tells them that he has Luke. Jerry wants to know  what Tracy will give in exchange for him.

Elizabeth looks at Jason after his bandages are removed and is pleasantly surprised by how he looks. Jason has no clue who he is as he looks into a mirror. An orderly calls Helena and tells her that Jason's bandages have been removed and that Elizabeth doesn't recognize him. Britt runs into Nina, who admits she's improved since she last saw her. Britt informs Brad that she's moving out and back in with Nikolas. Brad tells her that he'll miss her. Silas wonders what to do about Nina. Silas tells her that he had an interesting conversation with Travis. Nina attempts to play dumb. Silas tells her that he will never forgive her for destroying his relationship with Sam. Silas insists that their marriage is over after Nina tells him she did everything because she loves him. Jerry wants to know what Tracy, Sam, and Patrick will give him in return for Luke. Tracy doesn't want Jerry to kill Luke. Jerry wants ELQ. Tracy tells him that ELQ's not hers to give as Michael's in charge. Jerry argues with Patrick and Sam, and then leaves. Jerry tells Helena that Tracy is giving him her shares to ELQ. Anna tells Dante to find out the identity of the guy at the hospital. Liesl wants to know what Madeline is hiding. Nathan shows up and is furious to find his mother there. Madeline says she came to make amends with Nina. Spencer tells Nikolas he wants everything to be perfect for Britt. Nikolas and Spencer welcome Britt home.

Sonny and Shawn discuss getting rid of Franco. Sonny wants him gone before he and Carly get married. Carly isn't happy when she learns that Michael is back in town and insists to Sonny she has to marry Franco to stop the truth from coming out. Michael and Kiki show up and Michael wonders what they were talking about. Michael talks about opening a memorial clinic in AJ's honor. Carly thinks that is a good idea. Franco watches the footage of Carly and Sonny together and talks about torture on his wedding day. Silas tells Sabrina he's getting a divorce. Silas confronts Franco and wants to know how long he has been covering for Nina. Franco attempts to defend Nina and mentions the list of names. Brad tells Elizabeth about Britt moving back in with Nikolas. Jason asks Elizabeth about Nikolas after Brad leaves. Nina leaves Silas a voicemail after he failed to come home last night. Rosalie show up and informs Nina that she is getting the rest of her things and leaving. Nina needs her help to stop Silas from ending their marriage. Nina attempts to blackmail Rosalie. Silas shows up as Rosalie leaves. Ava tells Jordan on the phone that she's still suffering with pains. Morgan vows to protect Ava. Britt has a nightmare about Nikolas finding out the truth about her and Spencer's plan. Britt receives a call from Morgan about Ava and she tells him to bring her to the hospital. Jordan enters Jason's hospital room as Elizabeth quizzes him about what he remember about the accident. Sabrina later tells Jordan that Ava has the wrong medication and that it could cause premature birth. Morgan attempts to convince Ava to go to the hospital as Kiki shows up. Ava receives a call from Jordan and she then tells Morgan and Kiki she's going into labor.

Maxie tells Lucas about the Nathan situation. Carly shows up and  complains about Sonny. She then argues with Maxie about Franco. Josslyn decides that she isn't going to the wedding as she doesn't want a step-father. Bobbie later asks her daughter if she's really done with Sonny. Sonny and Shawn decide to frame Heather for Franco's demise. Michael runs into Franco at the hospital and they talk about AJ. Franco asks him to be best man at the wedding. Ava tells Kiki and Morgan that she is going into labor because she was given the wrong medication. Kiki suggests they get Silas after her mother refuses to go to the hospital. Nina attempts to blame her faked disability on Rosalie but Silas refuses to believe her. She then tells him she's in menopause and Silas suggests that they get her some help from a talking doctor. When Kiki shows up, she discovers the door open and Silas knocked out on the floor. Nathan calls Nina but gets her voice mail. Madeline comes out and thanks him for letting her stay. Madeline tells Nathan about Nina's troubled childhood. Nina shows up after Nathan leaves.

Felix attempts to be reassuring but Sabrina beats herself up for what she has done to Ava. Nathan shows up looking for Nina and they tell him about her sudden recovery. Nathan leaves before Sabrina can turn herself in and Felix thinks that she is being foolish. Michael bumps into Sabrina and he wants to discuss the clinic he is going to open on the waterfront in his father's name. Sabrina isn't happy when he bad mouths Carlos. After Silas recovers he tells Kiki about Nina's enemies list. Nathan shows up looking for Nina and fills them in about Madeline. Silas tells him about Nina attacking him. Morgan attempts to reassure Ava as she goes into labor. Silas and Kiki then show up. Nina is disappointed to see that her mother isn't rotting in prison. Madeline attempts to call for help but Nina grabs her phone. Nina then grabs some fake antlers off the wall and becomes threatening. Nina wants Ava's baby. Franco pays Heather a visit at the prison and she isn't happy to see him. Franco asks her to forgive him for choosing Carly over her. Franco then admits that she was right about Carly. Bobbie attempts to talk Carly into delaying the wedding.

Bobbie and Lucas discuss Carly's future happiness. Brad shows up to see Lucas. Brad and Bobbie bond over Lucas not telling them things. Lucas invites Brad to his sister's wedding. Brad is surprised to find out that Lucas spent four years at medical school after Bobbie suggests he helps him to get a job at the hospital. Carly argues with Olivia about a mistake on the menu at the Metro Court. Sonny and Shawn talk about how to make it look like Franco's mother killed him. Heather quizzes Franco about making Carly pay by marrying her. Franco turns on his phone where Carly's necklace is showing Olivia saying Franco should be locked up like his mother. Franco wants Heather at the wedding. Heather asks what Franco wants her to do. Franco informs her that he's prepared a film presentation that will destroy Michael Corinthos' relationship with his parents. Shawn lurks outside as Heather's returned to her room. Sabrina insists to Michael that Carlos didn't kill AJ. She insists that she knows he can be trusted and he is telling her the truth. Sabrina continues that somebody forced him to confess by threatening her and her baby. Silas asks questions about Ava's pregnancy. Kiki says Ava had stomach cramps. Silas says Ava's not yet in labor and gives her an injection to attempt to stop the baby from coming. Kiki receives a call from Michael about her mother. Nina tells Madeline that with her help, she's going to make Ava's baby hers. Madeline thinks that her daughter needs help instead of a child. Nina tells her mother that she has two options which are to either help her get Ava's baby or work at the local supermarket. Nina hides after Nathan shows up. After Nathan leaves, Madeline agrees to help Nina. Olivia thinks that Carly is throwing her life away on Franco. Sonny is convinced that the wedding wont happen.

Nathan asks TJ if he has seen Nina after he runs into him at Kelly's. Olivia wonders what Sonny is up to after he says Carly and Franco's wedding will never happen. Nathan wonders where Nina is. Madeline wonders where Ava currently is. Kiki tells Micheal that he can't come to brownstone and she will come see him. Ava thanks her daughter for her support. Michael looks at a picture of her father as he remembers the dinner with Ava. Sonny attempts to cover. Franco tells Carly that he can't wait to give her the wedding she deserves. Nathan and Rosalie run into each other. Morgan asks Silas if Ava will be OK. Michael tells Kiki that Ava could be the person who killed his father. Olivia wants Sonny to be happy. Franco looking at pic of his mother and Carly wonder. TJ isn't really interested as Jordan attempts to talk to him. Shawn shows up to see Sonny and tells him that Heather had a visitor. Michael tells Kiki what Sabrina told him. Nina tells her mother that Rosalie knows where Ava is but she is refusing to help her. Rosalie receives a call from Madeline. TJ tells his mother  that he knows she and Shawn are sleeping together. Sonny wonders why Franco went to see Heather. Carly is surprised when Franco tells her that Michael agreed to be his best man at their wedding. Nathan takes Rosalie's phone and asks his mother why she wants to meet her. Kiki lies to Michael about her mother's whereabouts. Silas tells Ava about the list Nina has. Ava is worried that Rosalie will tell Nina where she is. Nina tells her mother Rosalie's secret. Sonny tells Shawn to get Heather out of Ferncliffe tomorrow and he will then handle the rest.

Jason tells Elizabeth what he has remembered about the accident. Michael shows up at Metro Court to see Anna. Ned and Monica's picture is in the newspaper with news saying they are a couple. Julian show up and says that he is behind it. Sam and Patrick return home. Kiki telling Morgan about her conversation with Michael regarding her mother. Anna tells Michael that they have evidence which backs up Carlos' confession. Julian and Ned argue and Julian tells him that he has a series of articles to post about him unless he agrees to stop seeing Alexis. Alexis asks Sam about Luke. Tracy tells Sonny how Jerry Jacks is behind what has been going on. Liesl shows up and introduces herself to Jason. Julian also wants Ned to lave town. Sam tells her mother about Jerry and that he set up Luke. Patrick doesn't believe it though. Olivia wonders why Tracy would believe anything that Jerry says. Lulu isn't sure what to believe either. Michael tells Anna about his conversation with Sabrina. Liesl wants Jason out of the hospital as he has no medical insurance. Kiki is worried that Anna might reopen the investigation after Michael talks to her. Tracy explains that Jerry wants ELQ in exchange for Luke Ned refuses to give into Julian's blackmail threats. Alexis sees them fighting. Tracy wants Dante to talk to Micheal on her behalf. Anna agrees to talk to Carlos. Patrick thanks Sam for all her help. Anna quizzes Liesl about Victor' death. Sam talks to Patrick about Jason. Elizabeth talks to Jason about his supposed death. Alexis isn't happy with Julian. Kiki learns from Michael that he spoke to Anna.

Dante, Lulu, Olivia and Sonny discuss the Luke situation. Olivia tells Dante about how she has developed feelings for Ned  and he encourages her to act on them. Lulu runs into Carly and fills her in about the Luke situation. Monica pays a visit to Jason's gravestone in the family crypt. Alice shows up and Monica talks to her about her relationship with her son. Sonny later shows up to talk to Jason's grave. After the crypt door opens, Sonny is shocked by who he sees. Tracy tells her son that she wants his shares of ELQ and explains why. Ned doesn't think his grandfather would approve and neither will Michael. Tracy tells Monica and Alice about the Luke situation. Monica refuses to turn the company over to the man who killed Alan. Julian challenges Alexis to tell him that she really wants to be with Ned. Alexis accuses him of working with Jerry. Ned shows up with security. Olivia sees Alexis hugging Ned. Franco lies to Carly about his whereabouts and goes to see Heather again. After Franco leaves he bribes a guard. Shawn then shows up and manages to grab Heather. Elizabeth tells Jason how they never found Jason's body.and tells him about his history with the Quartermaine family. Elizabeth then takes him to the art therapy room. After she mentions Franco, something clicks with Jason. Carly comes face to face with Jason after Elizabeth leaves.

Lulu shows up at the Quartermaine house as Tracy receives a telephone call. Lulu grabs the phone thinking it is her father but it is Jerry. Jerry repeats his threats to Tracy. Jerry then asks to speak to Ned and Jerry threatens his daughter. Jerry calls back after he has had the certificates verified that he is given. He informs Tracy that Luke is on the terrace and she is shocked at what she sees after going outside. Madeline and Nina are in Liesl's office wondering where Rosalie and Ava are. Franco shows up and attempts to be friendly. After Madeline leaves they talk about his revenge plans and agree to compare notes later. Franco invites her to his wedding. Carly asks Jason if she knows him from somewhere. Jason offers her some advise after they talk. Franco shows up after Carly tells Jason her secret. Rosalie runs into Michael and he tells her about his suspicions of Ava. Madeline interrupts them and tells Rosalie how much Nina needs her. Madeline threatens to expose her secret unless she helps Nina. Madeline later advises her daughter to stay away from Franco and announces that she knows where Ava is. Ava tells her daughter that she is determined to give birth and disappear. Sonny sees a vision of Connie. Connie disappears when Michael shows up.

Franco interrupts Carly and Jason in the art therapy room as he assumes she's talking about Sonny. She tells him that she was talking about Jax and babbles. After Jason leaves, Franco tells Carly that he can't stand him. Franco talks to Carly about the surprises he has arranged for their wedding. Carly feels nervous. Liesl questions Elizabeth about Jason. Liesl doesn't appreciate it when he shows up and is rude to her. Nina demands to know where Ava is and her mother explains that Rosalie said she's with Kiki at the brownstone. Liesl show up and Nina thanks her for all her help. Nina gets out a pad and orders her mother to write a prescription. Michael is surprised  to see Sonny in the Quartermaine tomb and they talk about Jason dying two years ago. Michael tells Sonny that Carlos might not have killed AJ and how he thinks it was Ava. Sonny wishes he would drop it. Lulu, Ned and Tracy see a sack on the Quartermaine terrace. Tracy is scared that Luke is dead. They are shocked when they find Larry Ashton inside feeling drunk and disoriented. Tracy demands some answers but Larry doesn't have any. Jerry sends Tracy a text message explaining that he only promised to give back her husband, not which one. Rosalie informs Ava that Nina is looking for her. Heather is locked up in a warehouse and is not happy as Shawn shows up.

Sam receives an update from Tracy and Patrick shows up with the children in Halloween costumes. Sam and Patrick share a close moment. Britt attempts to convince Spencer to go Trick Or Treating with Joss. Maxie fills Lucas in on the Nathan situation. Spencer and Joss pretend they are a couple after Patrick, Sam, Cameron and Emma show up. Joss doesn't think Spencer's plan wont work. Diane shows up at Kelly's and gloats to Nathan about beating Scott in court. Nathan talks to her about Judge Walters ruining his relationship with Maxie. Diane offers her help. Franco shows up at Scott's hotel room looking for a place to stay. Shawn goes to see Sonny and informs him that Heather believes Franco broke her out. Sonny remains determined to kill Franco before the wedding. Carly tells her mother that she kicked Franco out for the night. Sonny calls Carly to tell her that he loves her and then wishes her good luck. Jason and Michael run into each other at the hospital and they soon discover they have comas and brain injuries in common.

Silas pays Ava a visit. Morgan is feeling paranoid having seen somebody sitting outside in a parked car earlier. Kiki is concerned that it could have been Nina. Morgan asks Silas to stay with Ava while he goes to speak with his father. Madeline tells her daughter what she has managed to find out. Nina tells her mother about her plan. Michael pays his mother a visit to wish her good luck at the wedding. He also talks to her about the new lead on AJ’s murder and that he’s determined to find out the truth. Shawn talks about the plans for Heather and Franco over the phone with Sonny as Jordan shows up. Jordan wonders what is going on. Anna shows up to see Sonny and tells him that she has learned that he and Shawn are planning to murder Ava. She also reveals Michael's theory about Ava's involvement with AJ's death.Anna warns him to stay clear of Ava. Franco edits his wedding day tape. Franco's helper from Ferncliff shows up and says that he was jumped and when he came to that Heather was gone. Kiki later shows up with a wedding gift. After Kiki leaves, Shawn shows up with a gun.

Jordan shows up at the warehouse looking for Shawn where she finds Heather. They talk about Shawn and the wedding. Jordan lets her know that Shawn works for Sonny and Heather manages to put the pieces together. Franco is surprised to see Shawn. Shawn tells him that he has a gift for him. Franco insists that having him killed will only ruin things between Carly and Sonny. Shawn tells him that his mother will take the fall for the crime. Before Shawn can shoot him, his phone rings. Heather sends him photos of her holding Jordan captive. After Shawn calls Heather, she demands that he let her speak to her son. Morgan confronts his father about killing AJ and Sonny claims that is just a fantasy of Ava's. Morgan manages to get a confession out of his father. Morgan explains Kiki knows as well but says they will stay silent if he leaves Ava alone. Sonny tell him that Ava killed Connie. Nina orders her mom to get rid of Silas. Madeline sees Sam talking to Brad by the elevators and comes up with a plan to get Silas to come to the hospital. Silas attempts to keep Ava calm. Sam calls him to say that Danny is sick again. Nina shows up after Silas leaves. Carly is able to get Spencer to admit that Franco knew he was hiding in her house and badgers him to explain why Franco was lying. Franco shows up so the wedding can get underway. finds Jordan bound in tape on the floor and Heather locks them in the warehouse.

Jason and Elizabeth have some fun and a laugh in his room and he surprises her with a gift which is a set of art tools. Sam asks Silas if Danny’s leukemia is back as Madeline secretly watches them. Silas looks at his notes says his cancer does look like it is back. Silas wants to have the tests run again to make sure that no mistakes have been made. Liesl finds her sister in her office and wonders what she is up to. Nina injects Ava with a muscle relaxer that causes paralysis. Nina loses it thinking that Ava is sleeping with Silas again after he calls. Nina tells Ava that she will never lay eyes on her husband or her baby again and continues that she’s taking Ava’s baby as a replacement for the one Ava and her mother took from her. Nina also explains that she plans to destroy Kiki’s life. Nina gets ready a second injection for Ava that will cause her to go into labor. Nina replies to the text message Silas leaves for Ava. Julian learns from Anna that his sister is a suspect in AJ’s murder. Julian refuses to tell her what he knows and leaves. Dante meets with Anna and she thinks that Sonny killed AJ. Dante doesn’t think that his father would do that to Michael, and he reminds her that Sonny was with Duke when the murder happened. After they argue Dane starts to think that maybe Anna was right. Carly speaks to Franco in private and she informs him that she knows about him going into her computer to get the recording about AJ’s murder. Franco manages to cover. Lucy shows up late to the wedding, believing that she’s held everybody up. The bridal march plays and memories of Sonny are on Carly’s mind and but when asked if she takes Franco to be her husband she goes ahead and says she does, After Franco is asked the same question everyone is shocked by his response. Sonny tells Morgan that Ava killed Connie and explains that he killed AJ because Ava made him believe that AJ killed Connie. Alexis takes Danny to the hospital and runs into Julian. Liesl presents Jason with a hospital bill and says they are discharging him.

Silas learns at the hospital that they can't rush blood tests anymore. Silas finds Madeline in Liesl's office and they end up arguing. Silas tells her that her name is on Nina's revenge list and they need to find her. Liesl informs Jason that he has to leave the hospital. Jason and Elizabeth are shocked by the bill she left behind. Elizabeth offers him a place to stay. Anna questions Duke about the alibi he gave Sonny. After Duke refuses to change his statement, Anna warns him that if any evidence comes up incriminating him, he'll have to face the consequences. Morgan informs his father that Ava is at the brownstone. Sonny receives a text message informing him that Franco is dead. Sonny gives Max some instructions to carry out. After a shot is fired, Sonny and Morgan discover that Max has been shot. Nina gets ready to inject Ava with drugs to induce the baby. Everyone one is stunned by what Franco has to say about Carly sleeping with Sonny. Lucy attempts to calm everybody down as Franco plays the footage of Carly in bed with Sonny. Michael defends his mother and Sonny until Franco plays the footage of Sonny's confession about killing AJ.

Silas shows up at Nathan's place hoping to find Nina there. Madelaine and Liesl talk about what to do about Nina. Max is rushed into the hospital following the shooting. Silas and Nathan show up at the hospital looking for Madeline. Ava starts to have some contractions after being drugged by Nina. After Ava gives birth to a baby daughter, Madeline shows up and tells her they have to go immediately. Ava attempts to convince Madeline not to let Nina take the baby. Carly attempts to convince Michael that what he heard isn't true as Franco turns the recording back on. Carly is furious with Franco. Michael tells Carly that both her and Sonny are now dead to him. Shawn admits to Jordan that Franco and Heather are a great team. Heather returns with a gun and explains that she put a bullet in Max. Shawn attempts to convince her not to shoot Jordan and plays the mom card. Heather leaves to go and see Franco.

Dante and the police discover Michael at the Corinthos compound holding a gun. He hides the gun and finds out that they are there to investigate Max's shooting. Michael tells Dante about Franco exposing Carly and Sonny's affair. Dante promises Michael that he will get justice for AJ after he tells him that Sonny killed him. Carly is furious with Franco for taking out his anger on her by hurting Michael. Franco defends his actions, due to the pain Carly caused him. Carly feels free because Franco now no longer has anything over her and tells him that she never wants to see him again. Scott and Bobbie stop Franco from following her. Kiki leaves Michael a voicemail asking him not to lash out. Heather points a gun at Kiki but she rushes off. After Carly shows up, Heather steps out into the open, aims the gun at her. Heather explains her escape and how Franco was giving her the opportunity to take a shot at her. Franco then shows up. Julian promises Alexis that  he'll be a donor for Danny again if his cancer has returned. Silas promises to be there for Sam and Danny as he says sorry for allowing Nina to get between them. He tells her that Nina has a revenge list that included Kiki and Ava on it. A doctor gives Silas Danny's results and they're negative. Diane cries over Max and demands that Sonny tell her who shot him. Morgan wants Sonny to go easy on Ava but he refuses to make any promises. Ava tells Nina how she first met Madeline. Nina demands some answers from her mother. Ava makes Nina believe that Madeline has the police outside waiting for her and attempts to convince her to leave the baby with her.

Felicia is surprised to find out that she has a chance to beat the other mayoral candidate. Lucy explains to Mac and Felicia about what happened at the wedding. Bobbie shows up and explains that Scott turned over a video to the police proving that Sonny killed A.J. and Carly is now an accessory to the crime. Duke believes that Sonny wouldn't kill A.J. Bobbie tells him that he admitted it. Duke thinks back to his last conversation with Anna and wants to warn Sonny, but the others stop him. Lucy doesn't want to see Duke to go down with Sonny. Anna thinks about Duke's statement giving Sonny an alibi as Dante shows up and tells her that Sonny killed AJ. Scott shows up and says he feels they've enough to arrest Sonny and Carly as an accessory. Scott wants Dante to arrest his father. Ava vows to find her baby as Sonny shows up. Ava informs him that she gave birth to a daughter and she was taken by Nina after insisting to him she had nothing to do with what happened to Max. Sonny leaves Shawn a message. Kiki tells Morgan that Michael has found out the truth from Franco. Morgan tells Kiki that her mother killed Connie and it's why Sonny wants her dead. Heather points a gun at Carly as Franco decides what to do next. Carly tells Franco that this is his chance to show he's changed. Franco shows up at the warehouse with his mother and Carly and Carly wonders why Shawn and Jordan are there. Franco tells her Shawn and Sonny planned to murder him at their wedding and to frame Heather for the crime. Franco ends up turning on his mother as well. Anna shows up at the bar as Duke is about to leave.

Anna arrests Duke and reads him his rights much to Lucy and Bobbie's shock. Bobbie and Lucy end up arguing. Michael enters and fires a shot in the air as Ava attempts to convince Sonny not to kill her. Michael informs Sonny that he knows all about his tryst with Carly and AJ’s murder. Michael allows Ava to leave. Sonny tells Michael that Ava killed Connie and allowed AJ take the fall. Michael accuses Sonny of poisoning him against AJ and that he cost him his life with his real dad and now he is going to make him pay. Michael is determined to keep his promise to AJ. Nina looks after Ava’s baby inside a motel room. Madeline shows up with some food and baby supplies. Nina receives a call from Franco who tells about the wedding. Sam thanks her father at the hospital for offering his bone marrow before going home. Ned interrupts Alexis and Julian as they are talking. Ned quizzes Julian about the last time he saw Jerry. After Michael puts down the gun, Dante arrests his father. Madeline wants her daughter to fulfill her promise and sign the finances over to her. Nathan and Maxie text one another.  Lucas and Bobbie talk on the phone about Carly not coming home yet. Carly, Shawn, Jordan and Heather remain locked inside the warehouse. Nikolas is furious with Britt for endangering his son and teaching Spencer that it is okay to lie to him. Nikolas then throws her out. Alexis informs Molly that her father was innocent all along. Tracy and Anna then show up and Anna apologizes since everything was all her fault. Jason sees a picture of Helena in a newspaper causing a memory to come back to him.  When he goes to the pier, Helena is waiting for him. The real Luke is revealed as being held in the basement.
